text:
maria: quick thought — i sketched an "interface-slab" approach to simplify hosted/dedicated/private boundaries. idea is to define 3 slabs: control-slab (manifest + auth), data-slab (runtime requests, kvcache), and ops-slab (telemetry, rate limits, eviction). each slab has a narrow public contract and explicit handoff points. thoughts?

sanjeev: i like the slab metaphor. helps avoid one-big-adapter smell. question: where do credential translations live? control-slab only, or ops-slab for runtime rebinds? :thinking:

joel: propose control-slab owns initial credential translation and short-lived leases. ops-slab manages refresh/failover hooks but cannot mutate tenant identity. keeps an audit trail.

maria: yeah — keep identity immutable after handshake. ops-slab can ask control-slab to mint a new lease via a validate/mint endpoint. minimizes leaked surface.

infra-bot: deploy-note: added provisional proto for slab handshake to /infra/protos/slab_handshake_v1.proto

tasha: curious about telemetry: hosted needs full request ids + token-level cost, private wants filtered metrics. ops-slab should offer a telemetry-adapter interface that returns pluggable views. make sure to include a "redact_level" param in the slab manifest.

joel: agreed. also add backpressure signals in data-slab API: {"status":"throttled","retry_after_ms":120}. that keeps hosted and dedicated runtime consistent.

maria: i'm attaching a tiny manifest example here:```yaml
slabs:
  control:
    auth_mode: delegated
    lease_ttl_s: 30
  data:
    batching: dynamic
    backpressure: enabled
  ops:
    telemetry_view: minimal | full
```

sanjeev: concrete next steps: 1) write up slab_handshake rfc (owner: maria) 2) proto review (owner: joel) 3) ops adapter POC (owner: tasha). i'll schedule a 30m sync. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — i'll draft RFC this week and flag compatibility tests for private mode.

tasha: quick nit — add a security note that control-slab endpoints must be reachable only from trusted controlplane subnets in private deployments. we should list allowed gateway patterns.

maria: good call. adding that to RFC. ping @sanjeev when you schedule the sync.

infra-bot: reminder: RFC template at /docs/rfcs/rfc-template.md

joel: ack. i'll review proto by EOD.

maria: closing loop: goal is to reduce adapter diffs and make rollback simpler. if anyone sees big gaps call it out here. thanks!
